name: Landscape Design II
brief: Explore landscape relationships between Tarsus and the Berdan river corridor. Establish a documented study area and investigate water, urban fabric, heritage, vegetation and public-space connections. Develop your own design question and programme using current evidence and your course requirements. Historical narratives require authentic, attributed sources. No specific student's design, drawings or objectives are supplied.
